'''Chax Jernil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. An underworld trader, Jernil made his base at the [[Drunkard's Vote]] cantina in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Commercial District]].

==Behind the scenes==
Chax Jernil appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a skill trainer for Underworld Trading on Coruscant.
